description: The deprecated functions / function_call shape is a spelling of tools / tool_choice and is translated (MAP-13: a pure spelling change is a translation, never a refusal). Until 2026-09-14 it was refused.

provenance.evidence: MAP-12 design (changes/2026-09-08-openai-chat-ingest.md (MAP-12, ratified 2026-09-08)); the body follows scrapes/openai/pages/chat--create.md § Body Parameters; the expectation was written by hand and checked against the reference shim on 2026-09-08 (reference message: openai-chat: 'functions' cannot be carried by a canonical Request — the deprecated function-calling shape; declare tools with {type: function, function: {...}})

amended.evidence: changes/2026-09-14-adapt-visibly.md (MAP-13, ratified 2026-09-14) §3c: functions/function_call translate to tools/tool_choice
